resources.name: KU Leuven|Tranco
quotes: Our measurement targeted 8,941 nameservers covering over 400 providers and tested whether they provided URs for the top 2K Tranco sites.

In our measurement, we targeted the top domains and nameservers since attacks of UR abuse the reputation of popular domains and hosting providers. To this end, we selected nameservers that host more than 50 domains in the top 1M Tranco sites.
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors used the Tranco list to select the top 2K and top 1M sites as target domains for their measurement framework.
